en-US.author: Superace Software Technology Co., Ltd.
en-US.copyright: © 2026 Superace Software Technology Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.
en-US.description: Edit, annotate, convert and AI chat with PDF anytime, anywhere!
en-US.longDescription: UPDF is a powerful PDF software that enables you to easily view, annotate, edit, convert, OCR, and organize PDF files. Its intuitive design allows users to perform tasks effortlessly, even without specialized skills. With advanced functionalities aimed at enhancing user experience, UPDF serves as an invaluable tool for business professionals, students, and anyone requiring PDF document manipulation. Integrated with AI technology, UPDF now offers even more robust capabilities, including summarization, translation, and explanation of PDFs.
en-US.name: UPDF
en-US.releaseNotes:
- UPDF AI has been upgraded to Nomostar, offering AI assistants for academic work, contracts, finance, and other scenarios, with support for custom quick tasks.
- Ask questions about the entire document, the current page, or specific pages, start new chats, manage chat history, and resume previous conversations at any time.
- UPDF Sign is now integrated, allowing you to sign documents on the desktop, invite others to sign, and track signing progress.
- Translate and split PDFs in batches, and run multiple OCR and full-document translation tasks simultaneously.
- Customize the toolbar and how files open, and choose whether to remember your reading state and show gaps between pages.
- Find and mark text, and select pages to print directly in the thumbnails.
- More practical features and experience improvements are available in the new UPDF 3.0.

zh-CN.description: 新一代 AI 智能 PDF 编辑器
zh-CN.longDescription: Windows 版本 UPDF 软件是一款简洁好用的桌面端 PDF 软件，可帮助您轻松查看、注释和管理 PDF 文件。UPDF 的界面设计使您无需任何技能即可灵活地执行任务。它也是商务专业人士、学生和任何需要处理 PDF 文档的人的优质选择。与人工智能技术相结合，UPDF 现在提供了更强大的功能，包括 AI 总结 PDF、AI 翻译 PDF、AI 解释 PDF 等等。
zh-CN.name: UPDF
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
- UPDF AI 升级为 Nomostar，提供学术、合同、财务等场景的 AI 助手，并支持自定义快捷任务。
- 支持围绕整份文档、当前页或指定页面提问，新建对话、管理历史记录，随时继续之前的交流。
- 集成 UPDF Sign，在桌面端签署文档、邀请他人签署，并跟踪签署进度。
- 支持批量翻译、批量分割 PDF，以及同时处理多个 OCR 和全文翻译任务。
- 支持自定义工具栏和文件打开方式，选择是否记住阅读状态、显示页面间隙。
- 支持查找并标记文本，直接在缩略图中选择需要打印的页面。
- 更多实用功能与体验优化，欢迎体验全新的 UPDF 3.0。
